newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to Monday's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600- 700 lbs few 58.50-61.50; package 714 lbs 62.50; package 885 lbs 55.25. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs 49.00-54.25. Holstein Large 2 package 575 lbs 38.25; 600-700 lbs few 36.00-38.50; 700- 800 lbs few 34.00-38.50.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 48.50-54.50; 700-800 lbs 52.50-54.50. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 38.00-43.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 2,200
